## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None — operator runbook task; closes VALIDATION-CLASS live-evidence gap. The story is VALIDATION-CLASS, requiring live evidence (197→0 post-bootstrap-throttle) at story closure. This task documents the operator commands and adds a Makefile target.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit additional target `audit-live` that wraps `audit-phase` for the bootstrap-throttle phase: `make -f Makefile.audit audit-live` invokes the full pipeline (dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5) against the live reconciler state, expecting Phase 2 (bootstrap-throttle) gate to be advanced. Document command sequence in plugins/dso/docs/runbooks/audit-live-runbook.md: (1) operator confirms bootstrap-throttle phase complete (pass 8 finished); (2) operator advances .reconciler-phase-gate to 'audit' or invokes runbook; (3) run `make -f Makefile.audit audit-live`; (4) verify dd2.json sc8_pass=true; (5) story-closure assertion: dd2.json artifact attached to epic 4047 with after_count=0.

## Test Approach
Given all phase 0/1/2 audits passed with stubbed bridge-fsck; When make -f Makefile.audit audit-live runs against the fixture; Then dd2.json sc8_pass=true is present in .reconciler-audit-artifacts/bootstrap-throttle/dd2.json AND a comment is posted on epic 4047 referencing the artifact dir.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] audit-live target invokes dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 against bootstrap-throttle phase
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_live.sh::test_audit_live_full_pipeline
- [ ] Runbook doc exists at plugins/dso/docs/runbooks/audit-live-runbook.md
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/runbooks/audit-live-runbook.md
- [ ] Story-closure assertion: dd2.json with sc8_pass=true attached to epic 4047 (manual verification at close — closure-check)

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit — Edit (add audit-live target)
- plugins/dso/docs/runbooks/audit-live-runbook.md — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_live.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
